key.name: left-click-action
key.description: Action triggered when the capsule is left-clicked: timer, media, notifications, workspaces, wallpaper, power, control-center, launcher

key.name: middle-click-action
key.description: Action triggered when the capsule is middle-clicked

key.name: right-click-action
key.description: Action triggered when the capsule is right-clicked

key.name: capsule-width
key.description: Maximum comfortable capsule width in logical pixels (240 to 640); media never grows this width

key.name: capsule-height
key.description: Minimum capsule height in logical pixels (44 to 80); natural text height takes priority

key.name: capsule-top-margin
key.description: Margin from the top of the primary monitor in CSS pixels (0 to 24)

key.name: glass-opacity
key.description: Glass background opacity percentage (60 to 98); panel adds four percentage points for readability

key.name: capsule-show-media-ticker
key.summary: Show playing media in the top bar capsule
key.description: Whether to show the playing media track and playback status in the capsule

key.name: capsule-date-format
key.description: GLib strftime format for the capsule clock

key.name: original-wallpaper-uri
key.description: GSettings backup of previous wallpaper URI for safe one-click restoration

key.name: auto-hide-fullscreen
key.description: Whether to automatically close panel and hide capsule in fullscreen mode

key.name: island-hotkey
key.summary: Global shortcut to toggle Island panel
key.description: Customizable keybinding to toggle the Dynamic Island panel
